## LLM007 maxTokens too small

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Level | warning |
| Framework | Both |
| Autofix | no patch; fix it by hand as described below |
| More | https://github.com/pgy763/llm-lint/blob/main/docs/rules.md#llm007 |
| Turn it off | `LLM007: off` in .llm-lint.yml, or `--disable LLM007` on the command line |

maxTokens is a ceiling, not a target. At 128, when the model wants to call a tool the argument JSON is cut off mid-write; the client sees Unexpected end-of-input, which looks like a parsing bug.

To mute it in one place, put `// llm-lint:ignore LLM007` on that line or the line above.
<!-- /generated:llm007 -->

## What it looks like

`ChatOptions.builder().maxTokens(128)`, or `max_tokens` set to a small number.

## How to fix

Leave it unset or give it a few hundred tokens. 128 truncates tool-call JSON and long answers mid-sentence.
